attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 374320)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Dark_Souls_III
Fandom (darksouls.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://darksouls.fandom.com/wiki/Dark_Souls_III
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1, but its Walkthrough page itself is missing and only three area subpages are written (Cemetery of Ashes about 12,400 characters, High Wall of Lothric about 22,100, Undead Settlement about 24,900), covering only the opening areas; other subpages are Gameplay, Controls, Character creation, Stats, How to fight and Table of Contents. That is not a full guide, so no structure was recorded and swUsed is off; it could be revisited if more areas get written. darksouls.fandom.com answers the API, with about 58 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Solstice" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 374320. 31 of 43 Steam achievements are hidden; they have no descriptions, so they were sorted by name only: "Lord(s) of Cinder" names to their own chapter, "Covenant:" names to covenants, and the three fire-themed names ("To Link the First Flame", "The End of Fire", "The Usurpation of Fire", 16 to 26 percent) to "The Fate of the Fire" because their names and low unlock rates suggest endings, which needs checking. The other 15 hidden ones are named after bosses or two places (Untended Graves, Archdragon Peak) and sit in Bosses and Areas, in schema order rather than play order. RAWG lists separate entries for "Ashes of Ariandel" and "The Ringed City", but the Steam achievement list has nothing for them, so they get no chapter.
